resources.resources: Named main/runtime/utility/worker entries and four per-window preloads
resources.review: Inputs are derived from each build config, including the separate runtime-status build. UtilityProcess and worker_threads launches use emitted basenames; the build roots retain all named entries.

resources.resources: out/private-connect including generated service-worker.js, public manifest and icons
resources.review: Separate HTML entry is derived from its Vite config. The generated worker is served by src/main/private-connect/gateway-server.ts and registered by src/renderer/private-connect/src/pwa.ts.
Native guardian and Windows Job Object sources/build tools are runtime assets, not TypeScript graph candidates. Keep runtime-assets.ts resolution, integrity binding and package checks.
Package-resolved PDF worker and canvas are external runtime dependencies. Graph reachability does not authorize pruning packages or native binaries.

resources.resources: package.json build resources, scripts/electron-builder.release.cjs, installer.nsh, AppRun hooks and platform icons
resources.review: Package metadata is included verbatim in JSON output. Release config, wrapper and helper scripts are tooling roots. Native launchers, fuses, signing, provenance, notices and packaging checks remain required.

resources.resources: Generated themes, renderer CSS, public files and imported media
resources.review: Non-module assets are outside the TypeScript candidate list. Their import/build owners and dedicated generation checks remain authoritative.

resources.resources: Released migration implementations and source path/symbol pins
resources.review: Pins are emitted separately, never counted as artificial production roots. check:migrations and migration fixtures are required before changing historical code. Recovery journals and local-storage importers additionally require persisted-format review.
